lines.text: Many learners say: I am used to play soccer as a kid.
Better: I used to play soccer as a kid.
For an old habit, we say used to.
The second! I used to play soccer.

data.wrong: I am used to play soccer as a kid.
data.right: I used to play soccer as a kid.
data.why: For an old habit, we say used to.

quiz.stem: When I was young, I ___ play soccer.

native.tip: “Costumava” é só “used to”, sem “am”: “I used to play.”

en.tip: For “costumava”, use just “used to”, without “am”: “I used to play.”
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I am used to play soccer as a kid.” The right way is “I used to play soccer as a kid.” For “eu costumava”, use just “used to”, without “am”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
